'''Teeko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]. Along with [[Teeku]], he was one of the uncles of [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="AHF" />
